Other professions (e.g. management consultants) are taxable only if the Act names the service; security and private investigation are also taxable. 2026-11-02: http://www.gov.mb.ca/finance/taxation/pubs/bulletins/056.pdf now redirects to https://www.gov.mb.ca/finance/taxation/pubs/bulletins/056.pdf, which no longer carries the quoted sentence (the page was revised); the citation keeps the old address and its archived copy.

summary: Engineering and architectural design services for a Manitoba project are taxed on a deemed 30% of the design-phase fees, so the RST of 7% works out to 2.1% of the fee.

conditions.when: design-phase services for a Manitoba project (tax on a deemed 30% of the fee)
pre-design work (feasibility and environmental studies, general consulting), construction-contract administration, post-construction or as-built services, or design for a project outside Manitoba
design of tangible personal property that is actually built, manufactured or constructed (taxed on 100% of that category of service)

citations.quote: Taxable architectural design services are deemed to be 30 per cent of the following services provided by an architect:

citations.title: Bulletin No. 113, Taxation Changes – 2013 Budget
citations.quote: The general sales tax rate will change from 7% to 8%,

citations.title: Manitoba RST Bulletin 058, Engineering Services
citations.quote: Engineering services provided under Category III in connection with TPP are taxable at 100 per cent of that category of service, when the designed goods are actually built, manufactured or constructed.

notes: Modelled as a reduced rate: 30% of the fee is taxed at the full 7%, which on the whole fee is 0.3 × 7% = 0.021. This holds whether the fee is hourly, a percentage of cost or fixed (Bulletins 058, 060). The rate applies to the design-phase billing (APEGM Category III for engineers; schematic design to bidding for architects) plus related disbursements; other phases are exempt and must be itemized separately, or the whole charge is taxable. Bulletins 058 and 060 were issued in 2004; the 2013 texts were not compared line by line. Made conditional 2026-11-01: the exempt pre-design work (feasibility studies, general consulting) is an ordinary fact of the job (d2-mb-16). 2026-11-01: added the 100% branch for designs of goods actually built (Codex verification).
